// Room "P1 kitchen" (interior designer's part). Inner air x26..28, z18..20, feet y2 (floor block y1).
// The hearth mouth is at (27,2,21) on the back wall, so the stove run sits along z20 in front of it. The way in is the
// west doorway at x25 (z18..19): the first cells x26 z18..19 stay clear, a 2-high lane runs across to the stove row.
// The table is a fence post in the NE corner with a pressure plate on top; two stair chairs sit at its west and south
// sides. A hanging lantern lights the middle; the lit smoker in front of the hearth is the brightest light.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  const legend = {
    F: ["furnace", { facing: "north", lit: "false" }],
    K: ["smoker", { facing: "north", lit: "true" }],
    B: "barrel",
    T: "oak_fence",
    C: ["oak_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }],
    c: ["oak_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }],
    P: "oak_pressure_plate",
    Q: "potted_poppy",
    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
  };

  // one layer per storey row of the kitchen: feet y2 (furniture), y3 (what stands on it), y4 (hanging light)
  layers(g, [26, 2, 18], legend, [
    [
      ".CT",   // z18: chair on the west of the table post at x28
      "..c",   // z19: chair on the table's south side, back to the barrel
      "FKB",   // z20: furnace, smoker in front of the hearth mouth, barrel
    ],
    [
      "..P",   // pressure plate on the table post
      "...",
      "..Q",   // potted poppy on the barrel
    ],
    [
      "...",
      ".L.",   // hanging lantern over the middle of the room
      "...",
    ],
  ]);
}

input.summary:
parts/room-12.mjs ("room: P1 kitchen"): the nine furniture writes were refused because shell-west claims every interior cell as air, so I removed them and kept the layout as a comment.
./make.sh now runs clean (no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE, build.nbt written), but the kitchen is empty and its lantern is gone.
No off-palette blocks were reported, and none were needed after removal.
left: The P1 kitchen has no furniture: stove, smoker, barrel, table, chairs, plant and lantern are all omitted. The designed layout sits in a comment in parts/room-12.mjs, ready to restore.

Root cause is outside this part: shell-west fills every interior cell of every plot with air (y2 up), and runParts locks owned air, so no room part can place anything in its room. The same lock will refuse every furniture write in the other room parts. The fix belongs to the shell owner or to runParts (let room parts fill shell air, or have the shell leave interior air unclaimed); I did not edit either.
With the lantern removed, the P1 kitchen has no light source, so `mcd room` / `mcd light` will report dark cells here until the lock is resolved.
Not verified in-game or with mcd walk/room; I checked only the make.sh report and the palette.

waste.what: Worked out which kitchen cells were claimed by shell-west by hand, by dumping per-part cells with MCD_PARTS_CELLS and reading the 5x5 grid around the room.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls, one probe build, one ad-hoc node script for the unclaimed-cell check
waste.tool: A runParts/layers preflight that reports which cells of a layers() call are already owned, and by which part, before the make run. Or a `mcd plan --owners` view of the lock.

waste.what: Learned the refusal cause by reading runParts' write() and the shell's fill line, since the report only says 'had air'.
waste.cost: about 3 file reads across two repos
waste.tool: The REFUSED line should name the owning part (e.g. 'owned by shell-west (plots 0-3)') and state that air is claimed, not just list the cell. The report also truncates refusedAt to 8 entries while counting 9, which hid the ninth (the lantern).

waste.what: Palette check is skipped for refused writes, because the owned-cell test runs before the palette test; this can hide off-palette blocks inside a refused part.
waste.cost: could not be seen from the report; had to infer from the code
waste.tool: Run the palette check before the lock check, or report both problems per write.

companions.task: Lay the kitchen run (smoker, furnace, barrel counter), table and chairs once the shell releases the interior air, so the furniture goes in after the walls and floors.
Hang the kitchen lantern and check the room's light levels with mcd light after the furniture is back, so the room has no dark cell.
